name: Den Sovy
source:
"Hi! Come to the institute reunion at 19:00. It'll be fun!"
I marked the message on my phone as read. A reunion... I never really had much of a desire to meet up with my classmates outside the institute building. A reunion... Although there is one person I wouldn't mind seeing again. So much time has passed... I think I'll go. As long as I don't miss the bus...

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210928050058/http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=550497327]Steam[/url]]

This unofficial prequel tells the story of the very first pioneer. He, just like Semyon, also once ended up in the mysterious pioneer camp, but for him, the days of the everlasting summer unfolded somewhat differently...
translation:
“嗨！来参加19:00的学院聚会吧。会很有趣的！”
我在手机上将消息标记为已读。一次重聚……我从来没有真正渴望在学院大楼外与我的同学见面。一场重逢……虽然有一个人我不介意再见。已经过去这么久了……我想我该走了。只要我不错过公共汽车…

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210928050058/http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=550497327]Steam[/url]]

这部非官方前传讲述了第一位拓荒者的故事。他和谢苗一样，也曾经落入神秘的拓荒营，但对他来说，永恒之夏的日子却有些不同……
